get.description:
Report that the process is up.

Deliberately does not touch the database: this answers "is the process
serving requests", and a probe that fails on a database blip takes the
application down with it.

Which login mechanisms are enabled.

[SPEC-0001 AC-0001-47]

post.description:
Local login, returning an access token and setting the refresh cookie.

[SPEC-0001 AC-0001-01, -02, -04, -05, -24]

Rotate the token pair without asking for credentials.

[SPEC-0001 AC-0001-06, -07]

Invalidate the whole refresh family.

[SPEC-0001 AC-0001-07]

get.description:
Report the caller's identity.

[SPEC-0001 AC-0001-08, -22]

The response model is explicit rather than derived from the ORM object, so
`senha_hash` cannot arrive here by someone adding a column (AC-0001-05).

post.description:
Redeem a reset link and replace the credential (SPEC-0001 AC-0001-31).

Open by definition: whoever holds the link cannot log in, which is why they
are here. 204 rather than a session, deliberately — unlike activation, a
reset may have been triggered by someone who is not the account owner, so
handing back a session would hand it to whoever redeemed the link.

get.description: Start institutional login (SPEC-0001 AC-0001-19).
Complete institutional login (SPEC-0001 AC-0001-19, -20, -21, -22).

post.description:
Invite a member (SPEC-0001 AC-0001-10, -13, -28).

The activation link comes back in this response and nowhere else. The gestor
delivers it through whatever channel the entity already trusts, because
there is no mail transport in this project and every account in the system
is born from an invitation.

get.description:
List members (SPEC-0001 AC-0001-15, -17).

Open to an auditor as well as a gestor, per §6. Not AC-0001-13, which is
about *managing* members and stays gestor only.

post.description: Block a member (SPEC-0001 AC-0001-12, -13, -29).
Unblock a member, with a justification (SPEC-0001 AC-0001-13, -44).
Deactivate and anonymise a member (SPEC-0001 AC-0001-13, -14, -29).

Issue a new activation link for a pending member (SPEC-0001 AC-0001-13, -46).

Returned once, here, like the first one; the earlier link stops working.

Trigger a password reset for a member (SPEC-0001 AC-0001-32).

The link comes back to the gestor, which v1.0 of the spec records as a
deliberate loss: with no mail transport there is no channel to the member.
The gestor cannot set the password; whoever opens the link does.

post.description:
Set the password and enter (SPEC-0001 AC-0001-11, -25, -26).

A session is issued here so that activation and first login are one step:
sending someone to a login screen right after they chose a password is a
place to lose them, and they have just proved they hold the credential.

history, none of which this project controls.
